title: Casper and the Hollow
author: Sebastian Reyes
blurb: Odile Montrose, a debt-bound temple scribe, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
